title: EUI MAECI Scholarships
provider: European University Institute (EUI) / Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAECI)
eligibility_summary: Students applying to EUI PhD programmes in Economics, Law, History, or Social Sciences. Must meet EUI admission requirements.
funding_details: €1,650 per month + €1,000 travel allowance + €1,000 insurance + tuition fee waiver
duration: Full academic year (renewable for up to 3 years for PhD programmes)

title: Sapienza University of Rome International Scholarships 2026/2027
eligibility_summary: International students applying to English-taught programmes at Sapienza University of Rome. All disciplines except Medicine and Surgery.
funding_details: Up to €8,200 per year (tuition waiver + monthly stipend + €250/year living allowance)
duration: Academic year (renewable for up to 2 years)

title: University of Padua International Excellence Scholarship
provider: University of Padua (Università degli Studi di Padova)
eligibility_summary: International students applying to Master's or PhD programmes at the University of Padua. All degree programmes offered.
funding_details: €8,000 per year + full tuition fee exemption + €150 annual contribution
duration: Annual (up to 2-3 years depending on programme length)

title: University of Bologna Study Grants and Fees
eligibility_summary: International students applying to degree programmes at the University of Bologna. All disciplines offered.

title: ITALYOU 4th Edition - Scholarships for Foreign Teachers of Italian Language and Culture
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
eligibility_summary: Foreign teachers of Italian language and culture. Must have relevant teaching experience and qualifications.
funding_details: €8,000 (paid in 12 monthly installments) + travel allowance + accommodation + insurance
